label: Bible Study
prompt: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for _____.
verse: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
note: Friends love at all times — and brothers are born for the hard days.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise _____ out.
verse: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
note: No one who comes to Jesus gets turned away at the door — 'in no wise' means not in any way at all.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him _____.
verse: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
note: Zacchaeus' repentance came with numbers: half his goods to the poor, and fourfold to anyone he had cheated.

label: Deep Water
prompt: That being justified by his grace, we should be made _____ according to the hope of eternal life.
verse: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
note: Grace does more than acquit the guilty — it writes them into the will as heirs.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: _____ themselves to be wise, they became fools,
verse: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
note: The great irony in eight words: 'Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools.'
